Help.title: Help
Help.subtitle: Quick answers about meetings in {appName}.

start.title: Start a meeting
start.summary: Start one now or create one for later, then share the link.
start.steps:
On Home, select New meeting.
Choose Start an instant meeting to join now, or Create a meeting for later to get a link.
To invite people from a meeting, select the shield icon at the top left, then Copy link. The passcode is part of the link.

join.title: Join from a link
join.summary: Open the link, check your camera and mic, then join.
join.steps:
Open the meeting link, or enter the meeting ID on Home or the sign-in page.
Check your camera and microphone in the preview, and pick the ones to use.
Enter your name and select Join now.

muteCamera.title: Mute and camera
muteCamera.summary: Turn your mic and camera on or off, and pick which ones to use.
muteCamera.steps:
Select Mute or Stop video at the bottom of the meeting. A red button means it’s off.
Select the small arrow next to either button to choose a microphone, speaker or camera.
Or use the keyboard: Ctrl+D or Alt+A for the mic, Ctrl+E or Alt+V for the camera (⌘ and ⌥ on a Mac).

share.title: Share your screen
share.summary: Share a tab, a window or your whole screen.
share.steps:
Select Share screen at the bottom of the meeting.
In your browser’s picker, choose a tab, a window or your entire screen. To share a video’s sound, choose a tab and turn on its audio.
Select Stop sharing when you’re done.

hearMe.question: Why can’t anyone hear me?
hearMe.answer: Check that the mic button isn’t red. Then select the arrow next to it and pick the microphone you’re using. If your browser blocked the mic, select the icon in the address bar and allow it.

shareSound.question: How do I share sound?
shareSound.answer: Share a browser tab rather than a window, and turn on the tab’s audio in the picker. Chrome and Edge can share a tab’s sound; Safari and Firefox can’t share sound.

phoneShare.question: Why can’t I share my screen from my phone?
phoneShare.answer: Phone browsers don’t let websites share the screen. You can still see what others share.

cameraInUse.question: My camera says it’s in use. What do I do?
cameraInUse.answer: Another app, often another meeting app, is using it. Close that app, then turn your camera on again.

free.question: Is {appName} free?
free.answer: Yes. {appName} is free and open source, with no ads and no tracking.
